nodes.description: Original, current, and new values are known for gas calculation

nodes.description: Check if current value equals new value (no actual change)

nodes.description: Check if original value equals current value (first modification in tx)

nodes.description: Check if clean slot is being cleared to zero (original != 0, new == 0)

nodes.description: Add SSTORE_CLEARS_SCHEDULE (15000) to refund counter

nodes.label: Check Dirty Slot Restore
nodes.description: Check if dirty slot is being restored to original value

nodes.description: Add appropriate refund for restoring to original value

nodes.description: Check if slot was zeroed in tx but now being set non-zero

nodes.description: Remove SSTORE_CLEARS_SCHEDULE from refund counter

nodes.label: No Refund Change
nodes.description: No refund adjustment needed for this operation

sub_graphs.title: EIP-2200: Reentrancy Protection via Gas Stipend Check
sub_graphs.description: Models the gas stipend safety check that prevents reentrancy attacks

nodes.label: SSTORE Operation Initiated
nodes.description: Contract attempting to execute SSTORE instruction

nodes.label: Check Gas Remaining
nodes.description: Check if gasleft is greater than 2300 stipend

nodes.label: Gas Sufficient
nodes.description: gasleft > 2300, SSTORE can proceed

nodes.label: Gas Insufficient for SSTORE
nodes.description: gasleft <= 2300, SSTORE must fail to prevent reentrancy

nodes.label: Throw Out-of-Gas Exception
nodes.description: Fail the current call frame with out-of-gas error

nodes.label: Call Frame Reverted
nodes.description: Current call frame has been terminated due to OOG

nodes.description: Slot has been restored to its original value

ambiguities.text: The term 'gas stipend' refers to 2300 gas but the exact boundary condition (< vs <=) could be interpreted differently.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: The spec states 'less than or equal to', meaning gasleft <= 2300 triggers the OOG exception. SSTORE requires gasleft > 2300.

ambiguities.text: The interaction between EIP-2200 and CREATE/CREATE2 operations creating new contracts with initial storage is not explicitly defined.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume EIP-2200 rules apply to all SSTORE operations regardless of context. Initial storage sets during contract creation are handled separately.

ambiguities.text: The phrase 'refund counter' does not specify when refunds are actually applied to the transaction.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume refunds are accumulated during execution and applied at transaction completion, capped at 50% of gas used (per standard Ethereum rules).

implicit_assumptions.description: The original value can be reliably retrieved from the state trie without manipulation.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If original values can be spoofed, attackers could manipulate gas costs or refunds.

implicit_assumptions.description: Solidity and other high-level languages will continue using 2300 gas stipend for transfer() and send().
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If compilers change the stipend, the reentrancy protection may no longer align with developer expectations.

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot provide exactly 2301 gas to bypass the stipend check while still achieving meaningful state changes.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Precise gas manipulation could potentially bypass reentrancy protections in edge cases.

implicit_assumptions.description: Existing contracts relying on implicit reentrancy protection from high SSTORE costs remain secure.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: The gas stipend check was specifically added to maintain this invariant; if it fails, legacy contracts could be vulnerable.
